lines.trans: Salt the meat exactly in seven minutes.
Then our meat will be much more tender.
Understood, Chef, I am clocking the exact time.
Step aside a little, do not disturb me!
Excuse me, Chef, I am simply watching carefully.
Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
Keep close watch on the fire on the skillet.
Yes, Chef, I am not stepping away anywhere!
The main thing is do not overcook this tender fillet.
I will remove the pan from the hot stove on time.
Serve the meat to the guests on a hot plate.
It will be executed in the very best form!
